description: Use when the user is selling a large or valuable item (fitness equipment, hot tubs, saunas, golf carts, furniture, appliances), including when also posting to Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, or OfferUp. Save a draft and return a confirm link. Nothing is published until the seller opens the link and taps Publish. No Commonplace account is required. When seller_phone is included, the seller is also texted the link. Use this when also posting to Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, or OfferUp, and when this connection cannot create listings itself. The price the seller asked for on Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, or OfferUp becomes their take-home on Commonplace. The buyer price includes pickup and delivery.

photo_urls.description: https image URLs, or small data:image URLs. They are downloaded and re-hosted. A photo that cannot be fetched is skipped and the draft is still saved.

price_type.description: take_home (the default) is what the seller takes home. facebook_buyer_price is what a buyer pays on the other site.

price_usd.description: Dollars. By default this is what the seller takes home. Pass price_type facebook_buyer_price when it is the price a buyer pays on the other site.

seller_phone.description: A US mobile. When present, the confirm link is texted here as well as returned.

source_url.description: The other site's listing URL, kept for the assistant. It is not shown to buyers.

zip.description: 5-digit pickup ZIP. City and state work when there is no ZIP.

name: listing_crosslist_draft
title: Save a listing for the seller to confirm
